about: How to cross each Act 1 zone fast. Community tips (sources below), checked against the game's own layout graphs (data/layouts/ggg, the owner's install, counted 2026-11-13). Directions from the data are relative to where you come in: they hold however the zone is turned. Evidence: docs/act1-zone-tips.md.

sources.data: The game's layout graphs: every possible layout of the zone, counted.

general.text: Lost? Hug a wall: it leads to exits and boss arenas most of the time.
The way on is almost always on the far side from where you came in.

G1_1.text: Straight on: the Bloated Miller guards the way to the encampment.
The large chest midway holds your first skill gem.

G1_2.text: The Grelwood is on the far side from town (29 of 33 layouts).
Beira (+10% cold res) is usually on the far side too.
Mud Burrow and waypoint on one side of the start, the Mysterious Campsite (skill gem) on the other.
Mud Burrow is rarely worth it (Lv 2 uncut gem).

G1_3.text: Narrow and winding: the Devourer is always at the far end (4 of 4).

G1_4.text: Follow the river: the Red Vale is always on the far side (12 of 12).
Orange mushrooms lead to the Grim Tangle, about halfway in (11 of 12).
Glowing roots lead to the Tree of Souls and the waypoint.
Found the Grim Tangle or the Red Vale first? Take its waypoint and come back.

G1_5.text: Loop round for the three Rust obelisks; the third summons the Rust King.

G1_6.text: Head away from the entrance: the Cemetery is always on the far side (8 of 8).
Once Una starts singing, respawn at the checkpoint to skip it.

G1_7.text: Lachlann's arena is on your half of the zone (10 of 12); the tombs lie halfway, along the side walls.
Found a tomb first? Take its waypoint and come back.
Ancient Ruins sarcophagus (guaranteed ring) along the far wall.
After opening the Memorial Gate, respawn at the checkpoint to skip the talk.

G1_8.text: Line from where you came in through the wheel tile in the middle: Draven is at the far end (3 of 4).
Not there? He is on the long wall in line with the entrance. His arena has a ribbed edge.

G1_9.text: Go through the middle: Asinia's arena is usually along the top.

G1_11.text: Points of interest sit in the corners: follow the edges, skip the middle.
Signposts lead to Ogham Farmlands, bloody tracks to the Crowbell (+2 passives).
Both exits are usually on the far side (Freythorn 5 of 6, Farmlands 2 of 3).

G1_12.text: After each ritual the locusts fly to the nearest one left.
The boss arena's black swirls point to rituals still undone.

G1_13_1.text: Head straight away from the entrance: Ogham Village is on the far wall (28 of 32).
Una's lute is close, on the way: behind a long hut with carts.

G1_13_2.text: Hug the right-hand wall up to the Executioner; the Ramparts open behind his arena.
Renly's tools: a room with a checkpoint along the wall.

G1_14.text: U-shaped: if it opens down-left, the manor is up-right; usually on the far side.

G1_15.text: Each floor: go the opposite way from where you came in; Count Geonor is always at the far end (16 of 16).
Stairs before Candlemass (+20 life)? Take the checkpoint and go back for him.
